## Red Flags

- **Over-scheduling paradox** · severity: high — Cadence sustainability 30.0 < 50 AND posts_per_week 12 > 7 — this calendar would push the creator past their voice in <2 weeks.. *Remediation:* Reduce --cadence-per-week to 5–6 (the established healthy band for mid-tier creators), OR keep the cadence but flag weeks 3+ as auto-paused unless voice fidelity holds in the prior week.
- **Format-streak guard fired** · severity: medium — 4 streak(s) of ≥3 consecutive same-format slots detected: slots 1-4 (thread, length 4); slots 13-16 (thread, length 4); slots 25-28 (thread, length 4). Streak slots stay in the calendar but are flagged.. *Remediation:* Rotate one of the middle streak slots to a complementary format (e.g. swap a third consecutive `thread` for a `single`) to break the rhythm.
